question: A sum of ₹10,000 was taken from a bank at the rate of 6% per annum to be compounded half yearly. How much has to be returned after one and half years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹10,000

Rate of interest (r) = 6% compounded half yearly

Time (t) = 1.5 years

**Concept used:**

Compound Interest formula A = P(1 + r/n)⁽ⁿt⁾.

**Solution:**

In this case, the rate of interest will be halved and the time period will be doubled as it is compounded half yearly.

Substituting the values into the formula, A = ₹10,000(1 + 6/(2x100))⁽²x¹.⁵⁾

⇒ A = ₹10,000(1 + 3/100)³

⇒ A = 10,000 (103/100)³

⇒ A = 10,000 × 103/100 × 103/100 × 103/100

⇒ A = 1092727/100 = 10927.27 ≈ Rs. 10927

**Therefore **₹10,927** ****has to be returned after one and half years.**
